Game Overview

Dune 2 puts players into a pixel experience centered on command your House in the timeless battle for Arrakis in Dune 2, a pioneering real-time strategy game. Defend resources, harvest precious spice, and wage war against rival factions. Choose your allegiance, strategize, and conquer to dominate the spice trade in this iconic desert conflict.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Dune 2 is easy to pick up. Command your House in the timeless battle for Arrakis in Dune 2, a pioneering real-time strategy game. Defend resources, harvest precious spice, and wage war against rival factions. Choose your allegiance, strategize, and conquer to dominate the spice trade in this iconic desert conflict.
